MenubarRoot.description: The bar, with the `menubar` role. The `MenuRoot`s inside it become one composite: their triggers are its items, one Tab stop moved through with the arrow keys, and at most one of their menus is open.

props.orientation: Whether the bar runs `horizontal`ly (ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move along it, ArrowDown opens a menu) or `vertical`ly (ArrowUp and ArrowDown move, ArrowRight opens, and menus open to the right).
props.loopFocus: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends of the bar.
props.disabled: Disables every menu in the bar.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the bar is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-has-submenu-open: Present while one of the bar's menus is open.
